verdict.rationale: Pendo is a SaaS analytics platform with AI features (Leo, agent analytics, AI tagging), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no documented policy, setting, or contractual commitment that excludes customer data from AI model training. The session-replay masking and the bulk-delete API are adjacent privacy controls, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit here.
